objective: Design proposal 04 of 4: L'Atelier, a package manager for Arch as a workbench. One 1600x1000 dark desktop screen, the FigCraft source, and the rationale.

inputs.tokens: the design-system tokens taken as they are: anthracite #111418, shell white #F7F3ED, muted #A1A6AD, slate #667085, signal orange 100 #FFE5D2 / 300 #FF8E40 / base #FF6A00 / 700 #C95400, royal blue 300 #87A0F4 / base #4169E1
inputs.derivation_rule: every intermediate tone is mix(anthracite, shell-white) or mix(slate, ...) at a stated ratio; no hue outside the tokens was invented

the_decision.the_two_axes: sources are trays in a permanent left column; the operations are tools in a rail across the top of the work surface
the_decision.the_third_operation: remove is a verb on a selected package, so it lives on the inspection card, not on the rail
the_decision.the_mark: a scallop shell of nine ribs in a metal cup on a brushed aluminium stem, 70px tall in the header
the_decision.the_empty_bench: the seventh tray is an empty dashed slot that suggests a search, and the mat carries a second EMPTY SLOT card naming the kind of package that would fit there

what_was_built.generator: build.py (emits build.jsonl; every layer is a figcraft command)

how: the PNG was read back and corrected six times: the mark (three passes on the shell geometry), the noise effect painting over a rotated frame's children, the fade over the settling scroll, the header breadcrumb, the keyboard legend, the density switch

artefacts.note: the rationale: navigation, material, motion, and the second pass
one question for the other three authors
the figcraft command log the .figcraft was built from

rules_kept: the Calix application code was not opened, the running application was not started, and no screenshot of it was looked for: the proposal comes from the brief alone
known_gaps: the fonts are system fonts (IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Sans Condensed, IBM Plex Mono); a render on a machine without them falls back
the cutting-mat green of the brief was not used: a green is not in the token set, so the mat carries the grid and a slate tint instead
